result.reason: The New York governing-law language matches the preferred position, but the venue position is not effectively achieved. The operative text retains mandatory arbitration and permits award confirmation in any court of competent jurisdiction, including where the opposing party resides, which conflicts with the newly added exclusive New York County court jurisdiction. The margin comment does not cure that conflict. The edit is otherwise limited and leaves unrelated provisions intact, but the inconsistent dispute-resolution provisions materially impair drafting quality.
